explanation: The requested eta point is physically allowed: W = 1.4885 GeV is 0.0024 GeV above the 1.4861 GeV production threshold. EXCLURAD preflight nevertheless warns that points within 10 MeV of threshold can make the integrator hang or silently return N/A, so run this point first as a short-timeout smoke test and verify its output. The input uses the validated eta-campaign defaults E_beam = 6.53 GeV and vcut = 0.166 GeV^2, with the full O(alpha) radiative correction.
